conservation.help_by: Use reef-safe sunscreen; choose operators that don’t touch or kick coral.
conservation.caution_against: Never stand on, break, or collect living coral.

life_info.eating: Symbiotic algae plus captured plankton. Daylight partners (zooxanthellae) live inside the tissue.
life_info.mating: Synchronized night spawning releases egg–sperm bundles.
life_info.habitat: High-energy shallow reef crests where waves break. Antler-like thickets shelter countless fish.

fun_facts: Named for branches like elk antlers — Caribbean reef architecture.
Critically endangered after disease and bleaching waves.
